personal-n1.text: School mode. One shared switch for every app, with a PIN set before it can turn on, the PIN needed to turn it off, a rename that replaces the name everywhere, and the plain statement that it is a user-experience lock. Try: turn it on (choose a PIN), turn it off with 1111 then 2468, rename it. Unbuilt: passkey unlock (shown as unavailable with the reason).

personal-n2.text: App name. Rename what the app calls itself in the title bar, rail, About and notifications; identity values below stay fixed and diagnostics keep the shipped name. Try: Rename, then Reset. Unbuilt: nothing; the real tool also records each rename in the local history.

personal-n3.text: ADHD modes. Five independent switches, all off by default, with a live preview: Focus dims (hover restores), Low stimulation quietens, Time awareness states facts, One thing at a time pins your next action, Momentum shows a dismissible note with Not now. Try: each switch alone and together. Unbuilt: real elapsed times (fixed here).

personal-n4.text: Scheduled settings. Ordered rules with precedence, a cross-midnight rule, and an external source shown as skipped with its reason. Try: change the preview time across 07:00, 09:00, 18:00 and 22:00, toggle weekdays, pick an external source. Unbuilt: HTTPS API and Home Assistant sources (need a main-process fetcher and credential vault).

personal-n5.text: Per-element appearance editor beside its target: corner radius, colour role, elevation, type weight and width, undo and reset, with unavailable rows stated. Try: drag the sliders, pick roles, Undo. Unbuilt: layers, per-state editing, animation tracks and transforms.

personal-n6.text: Infinite colour picker: continuous field, hue slider, translator rows, a gamut warning that keeps your input, and the animated rainbow with one shared speed level (motion off settles on one hue). Try: hue, the rainbow switch and its speed. Unbuilt: the eyedropper where the platform lacks it (shown unavailable).

personal-n7.text: App logo. Presets, custom image states (checking, byte mismatch, converted with reported losses, conversion failure keeping the previous logo) and previews at 16 to 256 pixels. Try: the state chips, Use this logo, Reset. Unbuilt: the taskbar and window icon (needs the main process).
